name: AEGIS Competition Lab
objective: controlled competitive decision-making under bounded resources with verifiable evidence and fail-closed scope enforcement

promotion_gate.current_revision_ci_source: latest GitHub Actions run on aegis-competition-v0.4

principle: AEGIS seeks initiative and information advantage; it does not wait passively for attacks.

audit.record_format: Ed25519 signature over schemaVersion, createdAt, eventCount, chainHead, and publicKey
audit.trusted_key_requirement: trusted public key must be obtained separately; embedded key is not sufficient
audit.persistence: scoped action ledger is locally persisted; copy evidence to separately controlled storage after closeout
audit.scoped_action_ledger: SHA-256 chained JSONL; replayed and validated on startup
audit.lock_policy: single active runner per audit ledger; stale locks require operator review
